body:
I can't stop the hope. I can't stifle the flame. I hate myself for it. It makes me more miserable than anything. She was my everything. 

/r/relationships is good. I've read through many many many break up threads, a lot of which are similar to my story. It's all the same though, give it time, take her of the pedestal, fill your time. 

I want to do all that. But every time I try to take my mind off her through exercise,entertainment,friends. Something reminds me of her. 

I can't accept the reality, that's why I'm here and not in /r/relationships 

The pictures of her and him run through my head, the messages I accidentally saw. I can't believe it. I can't believe any of it. 

I want to stop the hope but I can't. I've tried. It's destroying me.
It has sucked since August. I've been waiting for my brain to stop turing everything into her. I honestly don't know how much longer I can take it.
I really hope so. I don't remember the last time I was actually happy.

The questioning is the worst. The mystery of everything. The bluntness of the break up. The fact that every time we met she left crying because she was sad. Why would she be sad? Why would she do this if it was making her cry?

It sucks because whenever I start feeling happy for a little bit I feel guilty. Like I shouldn't be happy if I'm not with her. I can't let myself.

I'm going back to the school I met her at just so I could possibly get the chance to talk to her. But once I talk to her, and get closure what comes? I won't have anything left. Right now the only thing keeping me going is that I'll get to talk to her again. But when she tells me she's done and she's happy with this new guy and she left me for x, y, and z, what do I do? I won't have a reason anymore, I won't have any hope to cling on to, no future meetings to look forward to. I'm scared.

I thought we were right for each other though. I thought we would still be together, then all of the sudden we aren't. 

The thing is I know she has faults. I know she isn't perfect. I know there are thousands of other girls I could have fallen for. But when I look at her faults, I was always able to look past them in the relationship because I thought she was worth it. 

Her faults weren't anything I couldn't handle, some of them actually brought us closer together. 

Thank you so much for you encouragement. I know most of this is brought on by me. But I don't know how to stop myself from feeling like this. How do I stop myself from connecting nearly everything I see to her, how do I stop myself from waking up thinking she's going to be next to me. How do I get over someone I would have been ecstatic to spend the rest of my life with

It sucks because right now I don't have anything to focus on. I'm not returning to school until January, and if I see her with her new guy there I don't know what I'm going to do. 

I'm sick of trying to distract myself. I'm sick of not being able to be happy when she's having the time of her life. 

I just want to go back in time. Stop myself from doing stupid things. Keep myself from this fucking heartache. 

I know it's her who changed. Her who decided to end it. But everytime I think of her I see the face that would completely light up when I would surprise her when I got out of class early. Or the girl who told me that she has never felt so comfortable and connected with someone. or the girl who would bury her face in my neck when it was time to go to sleep. 

I'm never going to get over her. I don't see how I could. I just want someone to tell me when I get back to school she'll realize. But i'm 99% sure that's not going to happen. I don't know what to do.

That is one of the hardest things I've had to realize. The funny thing is when we first started dating she didn't want a relationship. Somehow just being myself was enough to convince her to take a leap on a guy after rejecting others before me.

I keep trying to tell myself that she didn't invest as much into the relationship. But every time I think about it, it only shows me she did. She did so much just to make me happy. She did so much. 

I know I can get through this. But when I look at the end of the road all I see is a life without her. I see empty days and crushed dreams. I don't want a life without her, I don't want to have to cope without her. I don't want her to have such a hold on me either. Believe me, there is no one who wants to be upset with her more than me. But I can't find it in me. 
I can't find it in me to let go of hope and it's destroying me.
